All third-party partners are contractually bound to protect and process data in compliance with applicable laws.

To exercise these rights, please contact us at bestmt4ea@gmail.com with “CCPA Request” in the subject line.

You can control cookies through browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.

8. Data Retention

We retain personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Policy, unless longer retention is required by law.

We use administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure.

Our services are not directed to children under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If such data is discovered, we will delete it promptly.

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal data.

  • Restrict or object to processing.

  • Withdraw consent at any time (without affecting lawful prior processing).

Under CCPA (California Residents)

You have the right to:

  • Request disclosure of collected personal data.
  • Request deletion of your personal data.
  • Opt-out of data sale (we do not sell personal data).
  • Exercise rights without discrimination.

To make a request, email us at bestmt4ea@gmail.com.

We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated “Effective Date.” Continued use of the Site constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
